brief:
Somalia told the UN General Assembly that it is bearing the costs of US-Israeli military operations against Iran, according to Middle East Eye. The statement came during a session focused on Middle East conflicts.

Yemen also addressed the assembly, emphasizing the critical importance of its security amid regional tensions. A walkout occurred during Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the 2026 General Assembly session.

title: Somalia, Yemen raise war costs at UN General Assembly
